mutation.from: try { Wait-Process -Id $id -Timeout 10 -ErrorAction Stop } catch [System.TimeoutException] { throw "Child $kind (process $id) did not exit within 10 seconds." } catch { }

error_messages: 'the stand-in process must be visible to the process table'
